Definition: probably from G2204; ferment (as if boiling up):--leaven.
BiblicalUsage: Zyme is leaven — the ferment a woman hides in three measures of meal until the whole lump is leavened. Jesus uses it both ways: the kingdom of heaven is like leaven, working quietly until everything is changed, and the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees is their teaching, which spreads the same way. Paul warns that a little leaven leavens the whole lump, and commands the church to purge out the old leaven.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe leaven is the picture of influence: a little hidden thing works through the whole lump, for good or for evil. I want the kingdom's leaven in me, and none of the Pharisees'.
